figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1. veA, mvlA, and ssmA gene
expression in A. nidulans wild type (WT),
ΔveA, OE::mvlA, OE::mvlAΔveA, ΔmvlA,
OE::ssmA, OE::ssmAΔveA, and ΔssmA
strains (RDIT9.32, RJW112.2, RJW220.17,
RJW221.5, REC1C, RJW216.15, RJW226.4,
and RJW215.25 respectively) grown in liquid
shaking GMM for 48 h at 37°C. RNA was
extracted from independent biological
duplicated samples. Ethidium bromide-stained
rRNA and gpdA are indicated for loading.

figure_candidates.caption:

OE::mvlAΔveA, ΔmvlA, OE::ssmA,
OE::ssmAΔveA, ΔssmA, ΔmvlAΔssmA, and

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3. Overexpression of mvlA suppresses
ors gene cluster activated in ΔveA strain.
A. Total scan HPLC proﬁle of secondary
metabolites extracted from the culture
medium of A. nidulans WT, ΔveA, OE::mvlA,
OE::mvlAΔveA, and ΔmvlA (RDIT9.32,
RJW112.2, RJW220.17, RJW221.5, and
REC1C respectively) strains.
B. Metabolites identiﬁed from ΔveA strain.
C. The yield of F9775A and B from ΔveA and
OE::mvlA ΔveA strains in 48 h GMM liquid
culture.
D. Relative yield of F9775A and B from
extracts obtained from 48 h liquid culture
media of the listed strains as compared to
ΔveA.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 4. Gene expression analysis of mvlA,
veA, and ors cluster genes of A. nidulans WT,
ΔveA, OE::mvlA, OE::mvlAΔveA, and ΔmvlA
(RDIT9.32, RJW112.2, RJW220.17,
RJW221.5, and REC1C respectively) strains.
36, 60 and 48 represent hours of growth at
37°C, 250 r.p.m. after inoculation to GMM
liquid media. Ethidium bromide-stained rRNA
and gpdA are indicated for loading. The ors
gene cluster is depicted at the bottom of the
ﬁgure.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 5. Transcriptional regulation of gcnE.
veA deletion strain is decreased by
overexpressed mvlA.
A. adaB and gcnE expression of A. nidulans
WT, ΔveA, OE::mvlA and OE::mvlAΔveA
strains (RDIT9.32, RJW112.2, RJW220.17,
and RJW221.5 respectively) strains grown on
liquid GMM for 48 h at 37°C. RNA was
extracted from independent biological
triplicated samples. Ethidium bromide-stained
rRNA and gpdA are indicated for loading.
B. ChIP analysis of H3K9 acetylation levels at
the orsA, orsD, and tubA promoters for 48 h
cultures. Acetylation data has been
normalized to total H3 in all cases. Letters
represent signiﬁcant differences at P < 0.05.
Numbers below each lane are gpdA-
normalized relative expression levels of the
mutant strains in relation to the gpdA-
normalized wild-type control, which has been
arbitrarily set to 1.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 6
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 6. Deletion of gcnE suppresses ors
gene cluster expression and subsequent
metabolite production in ΔveA.
A. orsA and orsE expression in A. nidulans
ΔveA and ΔveAΔgcnE (RJW112.2, TJW142.1,
and TJW142.2 respectively) strains grown in
liquid GMM for 48 h at 37°C. RNA was
extracted from independent biological
triplicated samples. Ethidium bromide-stained
rRNA and gpdA are indicated for loading.
B. Total scan HPLC proﬁle of secondary
metabolites extracted from the culture
medium of A. nidulans ΔveA and ΔveAΔgcnE
strains. Compound 1, 2 and 3 are the same
structures shown as Fig. 3.
